ribbon.tooltip: Changes the reference level of selected elements and adjusts offset to keep the same 3D position.
ribbon.longDescription: Use when geometry is correct but the wrong level is assigned (for example a large vertical offset).
cmd.noSelectionBody: Select one or more elements in the model before running this command.
cmd.noActiveDocument: Open a project document first (no active document).
dialog.title: Reference level
dialog.heading: New reference level
dialog.instructions: Pick the correct level. Offset will be recalculated so the element keeps the same Z elevation in the model (internal coordinates).
dialog.footnote: Note: instances hosted on walls or ceilings are not changed. Columns with a separate top level may still need manual adjustment.
dialog.pickLevel: Select a level from the list.
errors.hostedNonLevel: instance is hosted on an element that is not a level (e.g. a wall); use the manual workflow in Revit.
errors.noZ: could not read a reference Z from Location.
errors.levelParamReadonly: reference level parameter is not available (read-only or missing). This can happen for some families or hosted instances.
errors.offsetMissing: no editable offset parameter (Offset / Elevation) was found.
errors.wallBaseUnavailable: wall base parameters are not available.
errors.wallBaseSameLevel: wall base is already on this level.
errors.floorParamsMissing: floor level/offset parameters are not available.
errors.floorSameLevel: floor is already on this level.
errors.ceilingParamsMissing: ceiling level/offset parameters are not available.
errors.ceilingSameLevel: ceiling is already on this level.
errors.unsupportedType: unsupported type in this version ({0}). Supported: family instances, walls, floors, ceilings.
